top_signals.title: Access to Anthropic, Brazilian Assets Crater, Faith in Founders
top_signals.summary: "Bloomberg ETF IQ" focuses on the opportunities, risks and current trends tied to the trillions of dollars in the global exchange traded funds industry. Today's guests: Baird Strategas chief ETF strategist Todd Sohn, Founders ETFs CIO Lauren Cassidy, 21shares President and CIO Duncan Moir, Tidal Financial Group SVP head of business development Brittany Christensen (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.

top_signals.title: US Army practices digging temporary battlefield graves
top_signals.summary: The Army is preparing for the grim possibility of burying fallen soldiers on the battlefield, testing how fast it can dig temporary graves while preserving remains for eventual identification and return to families after the end of a conflict.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Colombia Launches Record Dollar Bond Sale Amid Fiscal Strain
top_signals.summary: Colombia is selling a record $5.2 billion in dollar-denominated bonds on Monday as a new administration pledges to rein in the widening budget gap and put the nation’s debt back on a sustainable path.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.summary: Cap imposed by Deutsche Bank’s asset manager aims to preserve liquidity and avoid gating fund altogether

top_signals.summary: The Pentagon announced that the USS Colorado will be the first submarine to join Submarine Rotational Force-West in Australia.
